mobileMoneyAccounts2025.label: Registered mobile money accounts in Ethiopia (accounts, not unique users; 12.2 million in 2020)

accountOwnershipWomen2024.label: Women aged 15+ with an account at a financial institution or mobile money provider
accountOwnershipWomen2024.sourceTitle: Gender Integration as a Market Systems Strategy, FSD Ethiopia (citing World Bank Global Findex 2025)
accountOwnershipWomen2024.note: FSD’s “Designing Digital Finance Markets That Work for Women” gives the same figures, citing Global Findex 2025, whose survey data are for 2024.
accountOwnershipWomen2024.quote: In 2024, 42 percent of women owned an account, compared with 57 percent of men, a 15-percentage-point gender gap.

accountOwnershipAll2024.label: Adults aged 15+ with an account (35% in 2017)
